note: Captured from the Nereus full stack (sim.launch.py active_control_model:=mpc mpc_model:=sim, robosub pool, rmw_zenoh_cpp) on a desktop under heavy load (other jobs running): rates are what this machine delivered, not robot specs. Each topic was measured alone for 3s with a best-effort subscription (rate_hz: pass 1, robot holding still before the tree run; rate_hz_pass2: pass 2, holding still after it); 0 = no message in that window, null = no publisher. sim_configured_hz is the rate the Nereus bridge is configured to publish at (0 = published on events, not on a timer; /clock is published every 2 ms physics step). On the real robot the topics the simulator publishes come from the sensor drivers and the firmware (micro-ROS) instead.
